purpose: Implement and smoke-test the forward BTC book data path after PMXT/Gamma remap audit found no fresh btc-updown-5m coverage in the tested PMXT hour.

verdict.summary: The forward recorder can now be converted into the existing distilled replay-cache format, but promotion still needs enough resolved forward windows, BTC tape alignment, and feed-forward validation.

pmxt_remap_audit.interpretation: A deterministic PMXT market -> Gamma metadata bridge exists, but the tested fresh PMXT hour does not contain the target btc-updown-5m condition IDs or token IDs.

change.input: record-btc-books output directory containing gamma_market_cache.json and market_ws_frames.jsonl
safety: validates every emitted event against Gamma token-to-market mapping
writes distilled files atomically via tmp file then rename
does not place orders or alter live strategy state

verification.distilled_gzip_json_check: passed: 17572 parseable JSONL records; first event book, last event chg

remaining_gap: The distilled cache solves the orderbook-data format gap. It does not yet solve market resolution attachment, BTC reference tape alignment, or the need for enough resolved feed-forward windows/trades/losses to satisfy strict promotion gates.
